correctness.rationale: Full tensor-space decomposition over F2 gives M=(d+1)I+sum J_i. Odd factors split into J_i eigenvalues zero and one. Even factors give J_i^2=0, one length-two block and q_i−2 zero blocks; an explicit h proves equal kernel/image on every tensor summand containing a length-two factor. This proves the formula for all allowed sizes. Explicit all-on solutions are verified algebraically; direct brute-force GF2 row reduction independently passed for 109 graphs and 6230 press equations. Finite checks are corroborative only.

originality.rationale: The 2017 paper establishes two-factor clique solvability but not arbitrary-factor nullity. Curtis et al. (2018) provide a general Jordan/invariant-factor method applicable in principle to every graph product, explicitly acknowledged; no closed uniform mixed-parity clique formula or unbounded gcd-gap evaluation was identified. This is an exact natural specialized evaluation rather than a claim of a new universal rank method. The all-odd case is excluded because earlier characteristic-coprime modular results apply. Residual bibliographic risk is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: The 2018 general nullity computation subsumes every fixed Cartesian graph-product instance algorithmically; this finding is only an evaluated explicit infinite-family expression.
An unindexed prior explicit mixed-parity formula could exist, despite targeted comparisons and searches.

value.rationale: Closed exact formula counts all binary null patterns and all-on solutions for unlimited dimensions and coordinate sizes, with constructive winning patterns and sharp unique-solution condition. More significantly K_{2r} square K3 realizes an unbounded excess 2r−2 over the motivating characteristic-polynomial gcd nullity lower bound, clarifying a natural question raised by 2017 work. The proof handles the nonsemisimple characteristic-two even-size case rather than a routine odd-order spectral substitution.
